summary: Two simul-climbing climbers fell approximately 140 feet on the Redguard Route; both sustained serious injuries and a rescue was initiated.
notes: Climb Year 2010 confirmed on page. [Merged 2026-09-10: RMRG 2010 page confirms 2010-06-26 mid-wall pick-off, ~3-hour pick-off plus vertical-to-scree evacuation, Alpine Rescue Team mutual aid; RMRG-published Redguard route rescue PDF linked.] [Merged 2026-09-11: RMRG rescue narrative page: climbers on 100-pitch day, simul-climbing after 29 pitches; leader fell 120-140 ft, stopped inverted and unconscious 15-30 ft above a ledge; runner on trail below raised the alert; 7:27 a.m. page, ~3-hr rescue, 32 mountain rescue personnel + 3 agency medics.] Boulder Weekly police-blotter account corroborates the 2010-06-26 date and Redgarden Route location; blotter gives an 80-100-ft fall with one climber sustaining head injuries (vs the ~140-ft/two-injured account in the RMRG and AAC reports).
